license.notes: The 1990s American street kit (roadmap 153). A 3 lb/ft galvanised u-channel post carrying one blade, named by the slot's `form`. REFERENCE: MUTCD R8-3a (the symbolic No Parking: a square white sign, black border, black P in a red circle with a red slash) at a junction corner; MUTCD W11-2 (a 30 x 30 in yellow diamond with the black walking figure) over the W16-7P diagonal arrow plaque at a footpath crossing; and a transit BUS STOP flag, which no part of the MUTCD governs. Mounting heights are MUTCD 2A.18 -- 7 ft to the bottom of a major sign, 5 ft to a plaque under it -- so the module's height is the sign's size plus its mounting height and the slot dims differ per form: no_parking 0.3048 x 0.060 x 2.4384, ped_crossing 1.0776 x 0.060 x 3.2112 (a 30 in diamond is 30*sqrt(2) in across), bus_stop 0.3048 x 0.060 x 2.5908. Lot's `site_furniture.BLADE_DIMS` is the same table. BUILT (pure, pre-bevel, 2026-09-16): 272 tris no_parking, 184 ped_crossing, 576 bus_stop, 36 the bare pole. Was a placeholder box minted 2026-09-12 by tools/new_species.py until 0.96.0.
